name: Trash Dude Hustle
detailed_description:
An action-adventure with 2-player co-op, where you play as a dude who was down on his luck and ended up on the streets thanks to an evil, filthy-rich mobster. The dude didn’t give up—he decided to fight back. Surviving the rough street life and clawing his way back won’t be easy.

Features:

  • Become a street legend
    Advance in level and boost various stats to make your dude all skilled up—upgrading damage, speed, health points, and resource multiplier. Choose a weapon to your liking and enter combat as a sharp archer or a reckless bat-swinger!

  • Explore unique districts
    Discover many unique areas in the game, from mysterious Chinatown to posh Luxury Hills. Why not take a casual trip to the Cruise Liner, the ancient Temple, or even the CIA? Unlock areas step by step and uncover the secrets they hold.
    Complete side-quests, uncover new pieces of lore, seize enemy bases to store more resources, and find shelter in the sewers to unlock powerful buffs for your dude.

  • Gather your gang
    Seek out other poor hobos across the city and unite them into one unbeatable gang under your rule. While your fellas do the dirty work, focus on more important matters—like taking over the whole city!

  • Play with friends
    Call your playmate to watch each other's backs on the crazy streets in 2-player local co-op.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U (4 * 1800) or equivalent; AMD Phenom II X4 965 (4 * 3400) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce MX 150 ( 2048 MB); Radeon R7 260X (2048 MB)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) or equivalent; AMD FX-8350 (8 * 4700) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 ( 2048 MB); Radeon RX 580 (8192 MB)
